blocks.x: Agentic AI & Hyperautomation for Fashion & Luxury — digital workers, decision hubs and self-healing workflows — governed autonomy at enterprise scale applied to the fashion & luxury operating unit of Retail & Consumer Goods.

Fashion and luxury sell scarcity, story and service: assortment risk (the size-curve problem), authenticity, clienteling quality and channel consistency. Technology must be invisible — but the intelligence beneath it decides which drops pay.

items: Piece allocation to doors by rule of thumb; hero-SKU shortages.
Assortment and buy decisions guess curves; end-of-season markdowns absorb the error.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Agentic Process Automation, Decision Intelligence Systems, Intelligent Document Processing from the Agentic AI & Hyperautomation tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Assortment and buy planning, Boutique allocation, Clienteling and CRM) on Achala Swarm and Achala Nexus and Achala Compass. Governance inherits the sector frame — GDPR among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: One automation spine — APIs, events, RPA and agents composable under common control.
Self-healing workflows — long-running business processes that adapt, retry and recover without tickets.
Agents that execute the work — tool-using, policy-bounded, and replayable for audit.
piece allocation proposed with sell-through policy (availability up)
